mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(YIELD*100,99990.9999)) AS INVEST_RATE FROM ( SELECT NVL(PA.YIELD,0) YIELD, row_number() over() as rownum FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE PA LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FIN ON FIN.CASH_ID = PA.CASH_ID WHERE FIN.FINPROD_ID = #{assetId} AND FIN.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' AND PA.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY PA.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
